_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 87 in the 16:03 run), SELECT MELEE WEAPON. Melee has no CUSTOMIZE screen, so the art is cropped from the same shot. Melee reports Hit Delay and Damage instead of the primary-weapon stat block, and has no trait chips.
name: Ice Axe

description.text: Primarily used for mountaineering, this Ice Axe also serves as a lightweight melee weapon. It can perform lethal takedowns on enemies when striking from behind or while they are prone.
